next.reason: 1985: "attempted on a file not open in the I-O, output, or extend mode"; 2023: "If the access mode is sequential, the file connector is not open in the extend or output mode.". A sequential-access WRITE in I-O mode now gets status 48, which the 1985 list did not give. The 44 case for a different-size indexed rewrite is gone; 2023 covers only sequential files.
